title: Analysis: FAST viewing surged 55% last year, but discovery and metadata haven’t kept up

facts.fact: Hub Entertainment Research's 2026 "FAST: Full Throttle" report found that 55% of viewers have used at least one free ad-supported streaming television service.
facts.quote: found that 55% of viewers have used at least one free ad-supported streaming television service

facts.fact: In the Hub 2026 FAST report, 46% of regular FAST users described FAST as a service they cannot do without.
facts.quote: Among regular users, 46% described FAST as a service they cannot do without.

facts.fact: In the Hub 2026 FAST report, 28% of respondents said they watch FAST every day.
facts.quote: Twenty-eight percent said they watch every day.

facts.fact: Amagi's June 2026 Airtime Report measured a 55% year-over-year increase in global FAST viewing hours, based on about 6,500 channel deliveries through its server-side ad insertion platform.
facts.quote: measured a 55% year-over-year increase in global FAST viewing hours, based on approximately 6,500 channel deliveries

facts.fact: Nielsen data cited by the article shows FAST viewing increased 550% over the past five years, compared with 135% for streaming overall in the same period.
facts.quote: FAST viewing has increased 550% over the past five years, compared with 135% for streaming overall

facts.fact: Hub reported that FAST users watch approximately 24 hours of television per week, compared with 22 hours for non-FAST viewers.
facts.quote: FAST users reported watching approximately 24 hours of television per week, statistically in line with the 22 hours

facts.fact: Hub reported that FAST users estimated spending about $75 per month on TV services, compared with $84 among non-FAST users.
facts.quote: They estimated spending about $75 per month on TV services, compared with $84 among non-FAST users.

facts.fact: In the Hub FAST report, 67% of respondents said watching television is an important part of their lives.
facts.quote: Sixty-seven percent said watching television is an important part of their lives

facts.fact: In the Hub FAST report, 60% of respondents said they use FAST as a complement to paid subscriptions rather than a replacement.
facts.quote: Sixty percent said they use FAST as a complement to paid subscriptions, not a replacement.

facts.fact: Hub's 2026 "How to Monetize Video" report, based on a June survey of 1,600 U.S. consumers, found low price accounts for 21% of factors consumers use to assess streaming value, up from 12% in 2025.
facts.quote: found that low price now accounts for 21% of the factors consumers use to assess a streaming service’s value, up from 12% in 2025

facts.fact: Antenna data cited in the article shows ad-supported plans represent 48% of all US SVOD subscriptions, up from 39% two years earlier.
facts.quote: Ad-supported plans now represent 48% of all SVOD subscriptions in the United States, up from 39% two years ago.

facts.fact: Antenna data cited in the article shows ad-tier plans accounted for 59% of gross additions in the first quarter of 2026.
facts.quote: Ad-tier plans accounted for 59% of gross additions in the first quarter of 2026.

facts.fact: Gracenote tracks more than 2,100 FAST channels globally, a 19% year-over-year increase.
facts.quote: Gracenote now tracks more than 2,100 FAST channels globally, a 19% year-over-year increase.

facts.fact: Roku reported that 87% of FAST viewing on The Roku Channel begins from the home screen rather than from within the app.
facts.quote: Roku reported that 87% of FAST viewing on The Roku Channel begins from the home screen

facts.fact: In the Hub data, 40% of FAST users cited quick access as a benefit, and 33% said finding new content was easier on FAST than on other platforms.
facts.quote: Forty percent of FAST users cited quick access as a benefit, and 33% said finding new content was easier on FAST services

facts.fact: In Amagi's survey of 28 senior media practitioners, 86% said reformatting metadata for different platform requirements was their largest operational burden.
facts.quote: Eighty-six percent said reformatting metadata for different platform requirements was their largest operational burden.

facts.fact: In Amagi's survey of 28 senior media practitioners, 71% said metadata supplied by content owners was incomplete and that the problem was worsening.
facts.quote: Seventy-one percent said metadata supplied by content owners was incomplete and that the problem was worsening.

facts.fact: In Amagi's survey, 57% of respondents said AI could already generate synopses, tags and genres reliably enough to require only spot checks.
facts.quote: Fifty-seven percent of respondents in the Amagi survey said artificial intelligence could already generate synopses, tags and genres reliably enough

facts.fact: In Amagi's survey, 68% of respondents expected AI to handle most metadata generation with minimal human oversight within three years.
facts.quote: Sixty-eight percent expected AI to handle most metadata generation with minimal human oversight within three years.

facts.fact: Wurl's CTV Trends Report, analyzing aggregated FAST platform data from March 2024 to April 2026, found 35.7% of news scenes were classified as fully brand safe across IAB-aligned categories.
facts.quote: found that 35.7% of news scenes were classified as fully brand safe across IAB-aligned categories.

facts.fact: Wurl's CTV Trends Report found heavy and habitual news viewers accounted for 6.4% of streaming devices but generated more than 80% of total news viewing hours.
facts.quote: heavy and habitual news viewers accounted for just 6.4% of streaming devices but generated more than 80% of total news viewing hours.

facts.fact: Gracenote's Q2 2026 Data Hub update found sports programming represents 5% of content catalogs across six major global SVOD services, up from 1.4% in November 2024.
facts.quote: sports programming now represents 5% of content catalogs across six major global SVOD services, more than doubling from 1.4% in November 2024.

facts.fact: The article reports that news channels on FAST grew 57% year over year.
facts.quote: News channels on FAST grew 57% year over year.

facts.fact: Hub found the share of value consumers assign to sports nearly doubled from 6.7% to 13% between 2025 and 2026.
facts.quote: Hub found the share of value consumers assign to sports nearly doubled from 6.7% to 13% between 2025 and 2026.
